summary: End-to-end testing of Cropbook cascade selectors (Dettagli / Economica / Costi / Bilancio) and new Vista Bilancio per Azienda. Backend pytest suite (9 tests) and Playwright UI flow both PASS. All cascade dropdowns, mode toggle, company grid, drill-down (KPI + lots table with TOTALE), back button, Vista Singolo Lotto toggle, and PDF endpoint behave as specified.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/www/js/cropbook.js exceeds 8950 lines — extremely large monolithic file. Consider splitting into modules (sections, cascade, bilancio, charts, pdf-export, etc.) for maintainability. Not blocking, but increases regression risk.

Bilancio mode buttons (#bilancio-mode-azienda-btn / #bilancio-mode-lotto-btn) — the default active state appears visually applied via styling but the .active class is not set on the default-active button on first load (`bilancio_az_btn_active_default` was false in DOM while screenshot showed Vista Aziende highlighted). Likely cosmetic / driven by another class; verify class naming consistency to avoid future test flakiness.

/app/www/routes/reports.js bilancio-azienda PDF generation issues N+1 queries (one SELECT per lot for each of economic_records / costi_personale / costi_mezzi_tecnici). For companies with many lots this could be slow. Consider a single GROUP BY query per cost source.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. The 400-empty-company test creates a TEST_EmptyCompany_pytest and deletes it in finally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login button does NOT have type=submit; use button text 'Accedi' or click via get_by_role. Section navigation is via `navigateToSection('<id>-section')` JS function (NOT showSection). Sections are: dettagli-section, gestione-economica-section, gestione-costi-section, bilancio-section, lista-section. Section nav circles (.section-nav-btn) appear inside each section's header. From main menu, click h3.menu-title text (Dettagli Lotti / Gestione Ricavi / Gestione Costi / Bilancio & Report). Cascade options format: `— Tutte le aziende —` + `Name (N)` per company.
verified_features: #cascade-az-dettagli: 4 options, filters #lot-dropdown-menu correctly (2 entries after filter)
Card click drills down: title 'Demo PDF Final', 3 KPI testids (ricavi/costi/finale) present + 4th 'N° Lotti' card visible in screenshot, lots table with 2 rows including TOTALE row
Vista Singolo Lotto toggle: #cascade-az-bilancio appears with 4 options, grid hidden
GET /api/companies → 200, returns list with lots_count, requires auth (401 without)
GET /api/reports/bilancio-azienda/:id → 200 application/pdf for company with lots (verified %PDF magic header)
GET /api/reports/bilancio-azienda/:id → 400 JSON {error} for company with no lots
